scope: Strict registered AI-synthesis task authorization receipt contract
checks_cover: OpenAPI request enums enumerate the registered synthesis tasks and summary types
Runtime request validation enforces task/summary pairings, UUID request IDs, and rejects undeclared fields before service access
The exact receipt fields, authorized status, and timestamp are validated and location/request-bound
New receipts preserve HTTP 201 and idempotent retries preserve HTTP 200
Malformed or mismatched service output returns a generic no-store error
The bounded service continues to establish signed location-scoped draft authorization
rollback: Revert the task receipt models/route validation, focused tests, and evidence; no database rollback is required.
